Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium travel-campaign artwork for TripVerse, a collaborative AI trip planner. This is ART ONLY; final typography and the exact logo will be added separately. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. Output a 4:5 portrait artwork at high resolution.
Supporting input 1: swirling blue sky and standing traveler; input 2: seated traveler and green valley; input 3: woven green landscape texture. Use actual recognizable scenery and humans from these references as collage material, preserve their photographic character and surreal flowing distortion.
Composition: warm bone #F7F6F3 flat background. A spectacular finely cut-out miniature world, an oval island of green alpine landscape with a single small traveler sitting on its front edge and a glorious whirl of blue-white sky rising behind, occupies x=12% to 92%, y=39% to 81%. Sculptural organic silhouette, crisp scissor-cut contours, beautifully integrated, editorial art direction, more realistic photographic collage than 3D rendering. Green streaks wrap like an orbit. Subtle woven texture drawn from input 3 only within landscape. At least upper 35% of canvas is completely plain bone for a large headline. Bottom 15% completely plain bone for copy. Keep outer margin 6%. Spacious, one visual idea, sophisticated and surprising, analog editorial travel surrealism, no heavy shadows, no gradients in the background.

Only left half x=0%-46% completely EMPTY bone for headline typography, top 10% and bottom 12% empty. Restrained coral red and cobalt within collage. Preserve actual strips and the scooter from refs, upscale beautifully. No surrounding heavy shadow, no extra decorative shapes. One striking visual.
